name: Benchmarking nonparametric Granger causality
description: An evaluation study measuring the robustness of nonparametric Granger causality estimators to downsampling and to choices in spectral decomposition parameters.
reputation: A specialized academic evaluation used in methodological studies of causality estimation; respected in the causality/time-series research community but not a mainstream ML benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on statistical estimators; sensitive to downsampling and spectral parameter choices, potential small-sample issues, and not directly comparable to standard ML accuracy metrics.
